## Description

A surface stored as a rational `B_SPLINE_SURFACE_WITH_KNOTS` is mathematically a `SURFACE_OF_REVOLUTION`. Common shape: a 3×9 control net rational B-spline standing in for a cylinder/torus revolved 360° (with the canonical sqrt(2)/2 weight pattern of an exact-circle NURBS) — exact analytic shape encoded via NURBS. Recognition matters for CAM and unfolding workflows.

## Reproducer recipe

BSpline surface produced by sampling a true revolution (axis + profile), with control net showing the rotational symmetry.
